title: Bizare Adventures of Dmitro Bizzare
head: Welcome to the oficial page of a «Bizare Adventures of Dmitro Bizzare» comic!
synop: When Dmitro, an ordinary, arrogant teenager, finds himself caught up in a whirlwind of mysterious events, he is not particularly surprised. He has lived his whole life believing that he is special. But when he starts making more and more unusual, sometimes even mysterious friends, whom he involves in extraordinary events, Dmitro begins to doubt his uniqueness. The plot of the comic is just as unclear, where on the surface the everyday life of teenagers is intertwined with the battle between good and evil, but behind the scenes, hidden forces and doubts loom. Then, both Dmitro and the readers begin to wonder what this story is really about. And is it about Dmitro at all...
not safe: Nothing is protected but please don't steal 🄯
